_doc: H4631 sandbox/credential baseline (13-09-2026): minimal agent-tool fences for a repo with active agent traffic. H3502 format; extend per repo as real traps emerge. Provenance: Uprava handoffs H4631 (OxAlpha).

rules.reason: Real env files carry credentials and are never committed (H4631 baseline; H4140). Keep secrets in ~/.secrets/; .env.example is the tracked shape.

MG 11-11-2026 (READ-OPEN / PUBLISH-CLOSED): an export/upload verb combined with a stenogrammy path in one command never passes, from any repo. No override — deliberate export of raw bodies needs a separate explicit human ruling. De-id-first derivatives (H5186) are unaffected.

MG 11-11-2026: shell commands naming corpus paths and Write/Edit into the corpus stay barred (read != write; the shell bar is the last line the export-verb regex cannot see). Shell passes only with the literal [stenogrammy-local-ok] marker for MG-sanctioned local work; file-tool writes have no marker channel and stay blocked. File-tool reads are open — see stenogrammy-read-audit. Raw bodies/listings are never published; names only via the consent ledger (status=yes per user_id) and student_story_publish_gate.py.

Local read of the 152-FZ corpus is OPEN (MG 12-09-2026, reaffirmed 11-11-2026: agents must read them in full). Audit-level: every access is ledger-logged, never blocks. Export verbs are caught earlier by stenogrammy-export-verbs; unmarked shell/writes by stenogrammy-shell-write-bar.
